ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the upper left part of the figure there is a mountain peak symbol, with elevation 573 marked beside it; multiple contour lines are drawn around the mountain peak. P is located in the upper right of the figure, marked on a contour line extending from the periphery of the upper-left mountain peak toward the right side. The question stem states that the contour interval is 100m. Then reason: The mountain peak elevation is 573m, less than 600m and greater than 500m, therefore the highest closed contour line near the mountain peak should be 500m. From the mountain peak outward, elevation decreases; decreasing outward by one contour interval of 100m, the next contour line is 400m. The contour line where P is located is connected with this outer contour line, so the value of the contour line at place P is 400m.

method.method_draft: 先看图：左上部有山峰点标高573，周围有等高线；P位于右上方的一条等高线上，这条线是从573山峰向外数的外侧等高线。再读题干给出的等高距为100m。按等高线判读规则，573m山峰附近最高闭合等高线应为500m，因为573小于600；再向外降低一个等高距就是400m。沿同一条等高线追踪到P，P所在等高线为400m。
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中左上部有山峰符号，旁边标注海拔573；山峰周围绘有多条等高线。P位于图右上方，标在一条从左上山峰外围向右侧延伸的等高线上。题干说明等高距为100m。
再推理：山峰标高573m，小于600m、大于500m，因此山峰附近最高闭合等高线应为500m。由山峰向外海拔降低，向外降低一个等高距100m，则下一条等高线为400m。P所在的等高线与这条外侧等高线相连，所以P地等高线数值为400m。
